properties.title: Lodha Bellissimo Sky Residence, Mahalaxmi
properties.description: Breathtaking 4 BHK luxury sky residence at Lodha Bellissimo overlooking the Mahalaxmi Racecourse and Arabian Sea. Features Italian marble, VRV central air-conditioning, Poggenpohl kitchen, private elevator lobby, and concierge service. RERA ID: P51900001339.

properties.title: Prestige Kingfisher Towers Penthouse, Ashok Nagar
properties.description: Bangalore's most prestigious luxury address overlooking Cubbon Park and UB City. Sprawling ultra-luxury penthouse with private heated infinity plunge pool, biometric access, floor-to-ceiling glass facade, and five-star club privileges. RERA ID: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/170915/000214.

properties.title: DLF The Camellias Golf Suite, Golf Course Road
properties.description: Unrivalled luxury on Golf Course Road directly overlooking the Gary Player designed golf greens. Private elevator, double-height grand living hall, wrap-around sunset deck, and access to the 1.5 lakh sq.ft Camellias Club. RERA ID: RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/2018/14.

properties.title: Rustomjee Elements Sea-Facing Residence, Juhu
properties.description: Opulent 4 BHK designer residence off Juhu Circle. Expansive sea-facing sundecks, Italian modular kitchen, designer bathrooms with jacuzzi, and a celebrity community. RERA ID: P51800000729.

properties.title: Total Environment Windmills of Your Mind, Whitefield
properties.description: Iconic earth-sheltered handcrafted duplex villa featuring natural stone walls, wire-cut brickwork, landscaped terrace garden with water body, and integrated smart home automation. RERA ID: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/446/PR/171014/000450.

properties.title: My Home Bhooja Sky Mansions, HITEC City
properties.description: Sky mansion at My Home Bhooja situated beside the Biodiversity Park. High-ceilinged 3 BHK with panoramic skyline views of Hyderabad's cyber corridor, German bath fittings, and 3-tier security. RERA ID: P02400000028.
properties.street_address: Silpa Gram Craft Village Road, HITEC City

properties.title: Oberoi Sky City Tower A, Borivali East
properties.description: Ultra-modern high-rise residence at Oberoi Sky City with direct private access to the metro station. Features imported marble, expansive clubhouse, Olympic swimming pool, and pristine National Park views. RERA ID: P51800003582.

properties.title: Sobha HRC Pristine Eco-Luxury, Jakkur
properties.description: Eco-luxury forest facing 3 BHK apartment near Manyata Tech Park. Unmatched Sobha German engineering quality, rainwater harvesting, organic orchard gardens, and clubhouse. RERA ID: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/309/PR/171130/002311.

properties.title: Appaswamy Clover By The River, Kotturpuram
properties.description: Waterfront luxury living along the tranquil Adyar River. 4 BHK with teak wood fixtures, Italian marble flooring, double-glazed soundproof windows, and private riverside walking deck. RERA ID: TN/29/Building/0122/2018.

properties.title: Tata Primanti Executive Villa, Sector 72
properties.description: European-styled 4 BHK triplex executive villa at Tata Primanti with private hydraulic glass elevator, rooftop terrace garden, basement entertainment lounge, and 24/7 security surveillance. RERA ID: 219 of 2017.

properties.title: Hiranandani Regent Hill, Powai
properties.description: Elegantly finished 1 BHK neoclassical apartment in Hiranandani Gardens Powai. Fully furnished with high-end appliances, modular kitchen, neoclassical architecture, and proximity to Powai Lake. RERA ID: P51800018620.

properties.title: Jayabheri The Peak Ultra-Luxury, Financial District
properties.description: Premium 3 BHK home in the heart of Hyderabad Financial District. Walking distance to Amazon and Google campuses. Features central air-conditioning, international clubhouse, and tennis courts. RERA ID: P02400000812.

properties.title: Brigade Gateway Sky Villas, Rajajinagar
properties.description: Located inside the integrated Brigade Gateway township adjoining Orion Mall, WTC, and Columbia Asia Hospital. Lake views, 5-star amenities, metro connectivity, and 24-hr security. RERA ID: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/309/PR/170916/000120.

properties.title: Godrej South Estate Landmark Tower, Okhla
properties.description: Godrej Properties flagship South Delhi development with copper stone cladding and MFIE air-purification technology delivering clean air indoors. High-spec luxury finish. RERA ID: DLRERA2019P0003.
properties.street_address: Plot No. 1, Okhla Industrial Area Phase 1

properties.title: TVS Emerald Peninsula Waterfront, Manapakkam
properties.description: Thoughtfully crafted courtyard-style 3 BHK residence with 100% Vaastu compliance. 72% open greenery, waterfront promenade, EV charging ports, and clubhouse. RERA ID: TN/29/Building/0199/2020.

properties.title: Kalpataru Avana Ultra-Luxury, Parel
properties.description: Towering above South Mumbai, this 4 BHK sky mansion offers east-to-west sea breeze ventilation, 12.8 ft floor-to-ceiling heights, temperature-controlled infinity pool, and helipad access. RERA ID: P51900000624.

properties.title: Salarpuria Sattva Luxuria, Malleshwaram
properties.description: Prime residential masterpiece in heritage Malleshwaram. Finished with Botticino Italian marble, advanced home automation, private elevator access, and wellness center. RERA ID: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/309/PR/171026/000843.

properties.title: Aparna One Smart Living Suites, Shaikpet
properties.description: Ultra-luxury smart homes equipped with voice-activated climate control, biometric digital door locks, central gas piping, and panoramic views of Golconda Fort. RERA ID: P02500001150.
properties.street_address: Old Mumbai Highway, Shaikpet, Jubilee Hills

properties.title: Mahagun Mezzaria Sky Condos, Sector 78
properties.description: Art Deco inspired 3 BHK sky apartment with double-height sundecks, VRV air conditioning, IGBC certified gold green building rating, and metro access. RERA ID: UPRERAPRJ3306.

properties.title: Casagrand First City Club Residence, Sholinganallur
properties.description: Grand township living on OMR IT Corridor. Over 100+ world-class amenities including a 1.5-acre grand club, squash court, rooftop swimming pool, and preschool. RERA ID: TN/01/Building/0114/2020.

properties.title: Godrej Origins The Trees, Vikhroli East
properties.description: Urban oasis at The Trees mixed-use township. Designed by Perkins Eastman, featuring retail high street, Taj Hotel within campus, and lush mangrove landscape. RERA ID: P51800000165.

properties.title: Assetz Marq 3.0 Garden Suite, Whitefield
properties.description: Modern 2 BHK apartment surrounded by 4 acres of central park. Natural airflow design, high ceiling heights, jogging tracks, and Olympic size pool. RERA ID: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/446/PR/171201/001150.

properties.title: Ambience Caitriona Super-Luxury, Ambience Island
properties.description: Seven-star living integrated inside Ambience Island adjacent to the 9-hole golf course. Private elevator, Italian kitchen with Miele appliances, and round-the-clock butler service. RERA ID: 08 of 2017.

properties.title: Rainbow Vistas Rock Garden, Moosapet, HITEC City
properties.description: Scenic lake-facing 2 BHK flat next to IDL Lake. Includes lakeside cycling track, 1 lakh sq.ft clubhouse, retail supermarket, and doctor clinic. RERA ID: P02200000420.

properties.title: Akshaya Today Smart Home, OMR
properties.description: Smart living on the bustling OMR corridor. Low-density residential complex with zero-water wastage, solar powered common areas, and high-speed fiber connectivity. RERA ID: TN/01/Building/0045/2017.

properties.title: Piramal Mahalaxmi Central Tower, Lower Parel
properties.description: Skyline living overlooking the Mahalaxmi Racecourse and Mumbai Harbour. Frameless glass windows, imported marble, infinity pool on 60th floor, and signature spa. RERA ID: P51900015854.

properties.title: Puravankara Atmosphere, Thanisandra Main Road
properties.description: Signature 2 BHK on the North Bengaluru airport growth corridor. Features a 34th-floor sky club, cantilevered viewing decks, and Japanese landscaped zen gardens. RERA ID: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/309/PR/180602/001859.

properties.title: ATS Knightsbridge Signature Tower, Sector 124
properties.description: Monumental luxury towers on the Noida-Greater Noida Expressway. Single apartment per floor, 360-degree panoramic skyline views, temperature-controlled pool, and 3-car basement parking. RERA ID: UPRERAPRJ2954.

properties.title: Phoenix Golf Edge Luxury Residences, Gachibowli
properties.description: Designer furnished 3 BHK home overlooking the golf green. Features 2 infinity pools, sky lounge on the 30th floor, private cinema theater, and squash court. RERA ID: P02400000340.

properties.title: Ceebros Boulevard Elite, Rajiv Gandhi Salai, OMR
properties.description: Contemporary sea-breeze oriented 3 BHK home on OMR. High ceiling layouts, acoustic double-pane glass, multi-tier security, and Olympic lap pool. RERA ID: TN/01/Building/0088/2019.

properties.title: Wadhwa 25 South Prabhadevi, Worli
properties.description: Direct Arabian Sea front luxury home at Prabhadevi. Bespoke designer furniture, master bath with sunset ocean views, private sundeck, and concierge desk. RERA ID: P51900000320.

properties.title: Embassy Pristine Lakeview Penthouse, Bellandur
properties.description: Stunning lake-facing 4 BHK duplex penthouse near Outer Ring Road tech parks. Private terrace deck, Italian modular kitchen, hardwood floors, and serene water view. RERA ID: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/170920/000305.

properties.title: DLF Magnolias Signature Condominium
properties.description: Prestigious golf condominium overlooking the DLF Golf and Country Club. Ultra-luxury interior detailing, automated mood lighting, wine cellar, and private spa. RERA ID: 02 of 2017.

properties.title: Prestige High Fields, Financial District, Nanakramguda
properties.description: Centrally positioned in Hyderabad Financial District. Full modern furnishing, air conditioned, clubhouse with badminton courts, pharmacy, and café. RERA ID: P02400000085.

properties.title: Olympia Opaline Park Luxury Towers, Navalur
properties.description: Lake-view modern 2 BHK apartment in a self-sufficient integrated gated community. Walking distance to Marina Mall and AGS Cinemas. RERA ID: TN/01/Building/0034/2018.

properties.title: Experion The Heartsong, Sector 108
properties.description: Spacious 3 BHK apartment along Dwarka Expressway. Surrounded by 20,000 sq.ft of recreation spaces, air-conditioned lobby, and rapid access to Delhi IGI Airport. RERA ID: 32 of 2018.

properties.title: Rajapushpa Atria Super-Luxury, Gachibowli
properties.description: Signature 3 BHK apartment featuring large format Italian tiles, concealed wiring, landscaped courtyard, infinity pool, and EV charging bays. RERA ID: P02400000220.

properties.title: Radiance Empire Prestige, Perambur
properties.description: Centrally connected 2 BHK home with quick metro connectivity to Central Chennai. Rooftop amphitheater, fitness zone, and children activity area. RERA ID: TN/29/Building/0076/2020.

properties.title: Lanco Hills High-Rise Condos, Manikonda
properties.description: Panoramic hilltop views in a 100-acre integrated mega township. High-speed elevators, Olympic size pool, supermarket, and pharmacy within premises. RERA ID: P02400000632.

properties.title: VGN Fairmont Signature Tower, Guindy
properties.description: Luxury 3 BHK residence adjacent to Guindy National Park and Kathipara junction. Excellent connectivity to Chennai Airport, Olympia Tech Park, and metro station. RERA ID: TN/29/Building/0154/2019.
